userRequest: 看看其他elo分过滤，你选一个不错的，先不训
验证集不变，避免无法对比
rule: Exclude a complete original-train game iff both known year-start train-only Elo values are strictly below threshold; exactly threshold retained; missing/unknown rating retained and counted separately.
rating: Use frozen v1.40 train-only year-start Elo; no full-corpus/final Elo, no recomputation after filtering.

selection.proxy: Among candidates retaining at least 60% of WTHOR-only complete train games AND unique positions, choose lowest recorded-vs-24-empty theoretical WDL disagreement; tie prefers more unique positions.
selection.scope: Training data only; no model trained/evaluated. Proxy is not move correctness or strength.

aggregation: Every retained occurrence contributes equally; preserve every action and W/L/D count; split D4 stabilizer-equivalent action mass equally; all policy sample weights=1.
holdout: Original 6000 validation boards/turns/targets/policy labels unchanged; original 6000 test also unchanged. No source/rating filtering on either holdout. Exclude their canonical positions from train as before.
limits: Data recommendation only, not a statistically established quality/strength improvement. WTHOR is not professional-only. Missing Elo not silently treated as low.
